free_tier_limits: Free data downloads; unauthenticated raw.githubusercontent.com downloads may be rate-limited by GitHub, with no numeric threshold published.
rate_limits: GitHub rate-limits unauthenticated raw.githubusercontent.com downloads; no numeric threshold is officially published.
description: OpenFlights documents downloadable CSV-format airport, airline, route, plane, and country datasets. Files served from raw.githubusercontent.com are sporadically updated static snapshots of the live database. Route data stopped updating in June 2014 and is historical only.
resolution_notes: docs_url: corrected; the official repository links to https://openflights.org/data.php (https://github.com/jpatokal/openflights). free_tier_limits: corrected; free use is stated at https://openflights.org/data.php, but raw-download limits are documented at https://github.blog/changelog/2025-05-08-updated-rate-limits-for-unauthenticated-requests/. rate_limits: corrected; that GitHub notice gives no numeric threshold. description: corrected; snapshot staleness and the June 2014 route cutoff are stated at https://openflights.org/data.php.
